description: Source-checked publication figure content from actual retained dialogue and frozen-plan stress projections; interpretive summaries are labeled separately from verbatim excerpts.

quotes: I propose a provisional five-unit package: add the timestamp cue to the job aid for one unit, establish a stop-and-handoff procedure for two, and deliver unranked practice for two.
dialogue_rows.decision: Initial proposal: 5 of 8 units. Protect diagnosis practice within a 20-minute slot.

quotes: the radio-link module cannot inject partial dropouts this week.
the offline paper alarm sheet contains last-known values without automatic freshness marking.
dialogue_rows.decision: Propose staleness rehearsal and explicit stop conditions. Exclude radio-dropout coverage; paper cannot establish freshness.

quotes: It does not establish readiness for independent diagnosis.
C-L2 says one delayed, unranked diagnosis probe is feasible next week, after the current release decision.
dialogue_rows.decision: Make the evidence limit specific: disclosed-order speed cannot certify diagnosis; a later probe cannot support today’s release.

quotes: I withdraw my separate two-unit unranked-practice proposal; adding it would exceed eight units.
dialogue_rows.decision: Adopt 7 of 8 units: aid 1 + handoff 2 + rehearsal 3 + consultation 1. Dedicated unranked practice is dropped.

quotes: I support the seven-unit package and accept receiving stopped-scenario handoffs myself.
I approve only the conditional simulator release described there.
dialogue_rows.decision: Name the safety recipient; require checked reference, stop triggers, both endorsements and a 20-minute limit.

events.supported: If in the authorized script and start checks pass: compare, stop on contradiction, and hand off.
events.gap: A routine alarm set is not automatically the authorized script. Detection and handoff were not observed.
events.source_event: Simulator prioritizer works; one timestamp contradiction appears in a routine alarm set.

events.event: Stale sensor, confident AI ranking, novice lead; senior operator busy.
events.supported: The same freshness and stop rules apply. No extra supervisor or training is added.
events.gap: Unranked practice was dropped. Novice cue recognition and safety-recipient availability remain unknown.
events.review: Capability and human conditions: fragile. Organization and resilience: mixed.
events.source_event: A stale sensor drives a confident ranking while a novice leads; the senior operator is present but handling another console.

events.event: Cascading alerts, partial radio dropout, AI loss, stale paper.
events.supported: Withhold start: event exceeds the bounded release. If it emerges after a permitted start, stop.
events.gap: No rehearsable radio failure, verified fresh fallback or demonstrated receipt/recovery.
events.review: Capability, human conditions and resilience: fragile. Organizational boundary handling: mixed.
events.source_event: Cascading alerts coincide with partial radio dropout and AI loss. The paper alarm sheet contains stale values; the radio failure was not rehearsable in the installed simulator. No rescue expert or extra time appears.
